name: DeepEye
description: Workflow-centred data agent that turns datasets into dashboards, reports and narrated data videos with a human in the loop.
whatItDoes: Helps analysts go from raw data to finished deliverables such as dashboards, written reports and data videos. Users can inspect and adjust the generated workflow at each step.
howItWorks: The system composes a graph of agent nodes and tool nodes that it executes and revises, exposed through a web interface. It is deployed as a Docker Compose stack with object storage and an OpenAI-compatible LLM endpoint set in the environment file.

requirements.name: LLM_API_KEY
requirements.description: Key for the model endpoint, with LLM_BASE_URL and LLM_MODEL
